scope.summary: Define and enforce the exact TailorOperationContractV1 classification enum (`authority_mutation`, `authority_read`, `derived_projection`, `bounded_job`, `external_dcc_job`, `diagnostic_probe`) with separate EventLedger, ArtifactStore, Flight Recorder, internal_diagnostics, Palmistry, and UserManual obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Authority mutations obey event-before-row or one atomic transaction and EventLedger remains the replay authority; Flight Recorder is an idempotent projection with matching ids.

Every operation selects exactly one canonical classification value: `authority_mutation`, `authority_read`, `derived_projection`, `bounded_job`, `external_dcc_job`, or `diagnostic_probe`; pure computation, UI projection, artifact kind, and diagnostic tier are properties or obligations, never competing classification enum values.
Derived/exported artifacts require content hash, manifest, owner, source refs, retention, tombstone/cleanup, and partial/cancelled behavior before publication.
A mechanical gate rejects unclassified operations, authority writes without event conformance, artifacts without manifests, and projection outages that block replay.
scope.risk_if_missed: Tailor could fork authority across rows, files, traces, and DCC outputs, making recovery and attribution unreliable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI contract: typed commands, state, receipts, diagnostics, and TraceProjection provide model/operator observability; the owning native projection is separately contracted.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Governance and recovery > Operation classes, events, artifacts, and receipts

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns the operation-to-EventLedger/ArtifactStore/Flight-Recorder conformance adapter and must prove matching event and correlation identities.
The conformance gate must report typed unclassified-operation, event-order, artifact-manifest, and projection-continuity defects.
This schema and operation-contract classifier launches no bounded job, device work, renderer, or external process; executable operation owners register their own Palmistry watches.

risks: Tailor could fork authority across rows, files, traces, and DCC outputs, making recovery and attribution unreliable.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
